meta.title: ANATOMICA skeletal geometry resolution — Milestone 2
meta.paths: mesh paths are relative to the project root; meshes are the extracted BP3D 4.0 working copies under work/bp3d/ (sources in data/sources/ stay byte-identical)
meta.units: OBJ header states 'Bounds(mm)' — source coordinates are millimetres (verified by measurement in tools/register_sketch.md)
meta.counting: vertices = lines starting 'v ', faces = lines starting 'f ', counted by streaming each file; bbox measured from the same vertex stream — no header values trusted
meta.composition: isa_meshes = the concept's element files in isa_element_parts.txt (its IS-A composition); partof_meshes = its element files in partof_element_parts.txt (its PART-OF part composition). The two archives are alternative segmentations of the same body, listed separately, never merged.
